annotation.title_clean: Decision No 2/2017 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment of 22 December 2017
annotation.title_en: Decision No 2/2017 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment of 22 December 2017
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Committee established under the EC–Swiss Agreement on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 72/24
annotation.summary_en: EU–Switzerland joint committee decision updating the mutual recognition agreement on conformity assessment for personal protective equipment, medical devices, gas appliances and cableway installations, reflecting new EU regulations. It covers notified body designation, economic operator obligations, market surveillance cooperation and safeguard procedures. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces Annex 1 chapters on PPE, medical devices, gas appliances and cableways to reflect new EU regulations
Mutual recognition of conformity assessment bodies and certificates under Regulations 2017/745 and 2017/746
Equivalent obligations for EU and Swiss economic operators, with simplified labelling and documentation retention
Market surveillance cooperation and safeguard procedures for risky products
Disagreements escalated to the joint Committee
